# Country Beach Escape

> Direct-booking guide for Country Beach Escape, a four-bedroom holiday home in Ballymoney near Gorey, County Wexford, Ireland.

Country Beach Escape sleeps up to eight guests and includes four bedrooms, a private hot tub, a large private garden, outdoor dining and family-friendly facilities. It is in a quiet gated community close to Ballymoney Beach and is suitable for family holidays, coastal breaks, golf trips and relaxed stays. Dogs are welcome subject to the house rules.

## Essential facts

- Location: Ballymoney, near Gorey, County Wexford, Ireland
- Accommodation: Four-bedroom self-catering holiday home
- Capacity: Up to eight guests
- Facilities: Private hot tub, private garden, outdoor dining, Wi-Fi, family facilities and pet-friendly accommodation
- Gorey: Approximately 10 minutes by car
- Courtown: Approximately 10 minutes by car
- M11 access: Approximately five minutes from the house
- Direct booking: Contact Julianne for availability, rates and booking information

## Local guide

The Local Guide covers Ballymoney and Gorey beaches, walks and trails, restaurants and pubs, markets and shopping, family activities, rainy-day activities, swimming pools, spas, golf, gardens and transport.

## Booking

Direct booking offers the widest choice of dates and the best available direct rate. Guests can contact Julianne through the Contact page or WhatsApp link. The website's calendar shows Airbnb availability only; direct booking may have additional availability.

## Source of truth

For current availability, rates, seasonal opening times and house rules, use the pages above or contact Julianne directly.
